# 직접 작성, CC0 (Written by hand for tests, public domain dedication CC0). Not a real song.
# Format: lines starting with '#' are comments; a blank line starts a new stanza; every other line is one sung line.
The kettle hums while the morning climbs the wall
I count my steps to the old blue chair
Nobody calls, so the quiet stays small

A paper boat rides the puddle by the gate
I whistle one note and watch it drift
Tomorrow can wait while the tea is warm
